title: ScriptReview
description: Review checklist for commentary script quality

source_fidelity_ok.description: Whether the script preserves the source article's factual boundaries without drifting, overstating, or dropping core evidence.

spoken_density_ok.description: Whether the spoken lines are light enough for host/guest delivery instead of sounding like compressed source prose.

evidence_usage_ok.description: Whether major commentary claims are backed by source evidence rather than slogan-like summary.

promo_tone_ok.description: Whether the script avoids unnecessary hype, promo language, or unsupported triumphal phrasing.

overcompressed_source_blocks.description: Lines that feel like compressed source paragraphs rather than spoken commentary.

missing_hard_evidence.description: Important evidence or concrete source details that should remain in the script.

unsupported_commentary_claims.description: Interpretive or evaluative claims that are not sufficiently supported by the source pack.

promo_tone_risk_lines.description: Lines that should be rewritten into a more neutral or evidence-first tone.

visual_should_replace_spoken.description: Details better moved to cards, charts, or source visuals rather than spoken aloud.
